title: One request through the pipeline (storefront edge, a state-changing call)
caption: The order of ota/docs/architecture.md §3, as main.ts and app.module.ts register it: Express middleware, then every guard (caller, tenant, scope, customer, staff, CSRF, rate limit, permission; the booking-access guard on booking routes), then the interceptors (OpenAPI validation, idempotency) around the controller. Invalid requests therefore still count against the rate limits. No transaction stays open across an Amadeus or Stripe call.

actors.label: Express middleware (cls, body, helmet, CORS, cookies)
Guards (caller, tenant, scope, session, CSRF, throttler, permission)

steps.label: X-Request-Id; JSON ≤ 256 KB (10 KB airline card, raw body on /webhooks); helmet; Vary: Origin; cookie-parser
CallerGuard: edge secret compared in constant time (before any lookup)
TenantGuard: host:<hostname> → tenant:<id> (60 s), else platform.tenant_domains / tenants
ScopeGuard (x-scope), CustomerGuard / StaffGuard (tokens, cookies), CsrfGuard (cookie = X-CSRF-Token, Origin = host)
RateLimitGuard rl:ota_<limit>:<sha256> (Redis down → 503); PermissionGuard in console scope (403 + denied staff_actions row)
OpenAPI validation (Ajv): 400 VALIDATION_FAILED with field paths, never values
Idempotency: claim idempotency_keys row (processing) or replay a stored answer
tenantTx: set_config(search_path = tenant_demo, reference), statement_timeout 15 s; DML; COMMIT
result; idempotency row completed (redacted body, tokens encrypted)
201 + JSON; errors in one envelope {error:{code,message,status,requestId,details?,fieldErrors?,supplier?}}
steps.note: Unknown errors become 500 INTERNAL_ERROR; supplier details only in console scope.
